description: Hashim Al-Majali and Muhannad Abu Dagar are genetic engineers. We are looking for two and two programmers specializing in earth and environmental sciences.
summary: Farmers worldwide face severe agricultural challenges due to climate change, temperature fluctuations, drought, and soil degradation. To solve this, we developed Eco-CROP (Eco-Adaptive Crop Rotation & Soil Health Intelligence Engine), an advanced decision-support tool bridging NASA's Earth observation data with local field realities. The system uses an Adaptive Dynamic Decision Engine that evaluates environmental metrics (Temperature, pH, Volumetric Soil Moisture) against optimal biological thresholds. It features a smart Dynamic Layer-Skipping Mechanism to bypass healthy parameters and target true operational deficits, alongside an Intersection Filtering Logic to handle complex stress conditions and recommend highly resilient, climate-adapted crop rotations tailored specifically for regions like Al-Qasr District, Karak, Jordan.
details:
Project Overview & Methodology:

Farmers worldwide face unprecedented challenges due to climate change, manifested by temperature fluctuations, drought, and soil degradation. To solve this, Eco-CROP emerges as an advanced decision-support tool bridging NASA's Earth observation data with local field realities.  

How it Works:

The system utilizes an Adaptive Dynamic Decision Engine that processes multidimensional data and localized metrics against optimal biological thresholds. Key features include:  

Hierarchical Priority Flow: Systematically addresses primary climatic stressors (temperature and aridity) down to soil hydrology and chemical properties (pH).

Dynamic Layer-Skipping Mechanism: Automatically bypasses healthy environmental indicators (where Measured equals Optimal) to target true operational deficits and optimize computational efficiency.  

Intersection Filtering Logic & Case Study Validation: Tested successfully in Al-Qasr District, Karak, Jordan, using live NASA satellite observations and Meteomatics weather APIs to deliver field-ready, climate-resilient crop rotation recommendations.
